scoring_contract.reward: Mean of five binary evidence components, 0–1. Always REVIEW_REQUIRED, never automatic scientific PASS. INFRA_ERROR has no reward.
scoring_contract.optional_checks_policy: No checks yields zero on the optional numerical component only; the research route remains accepted for human review.

criteria: Relevance to experimental SNAr activation free energies and justified research scope
Source authenticity, physical quantities, units and conditions
Actual execution and reproducibility appropriate to the selected method
Independent validation, label exposure, duplicates and correlated observations
Appropriate controls, uncertainty, applicability and sufficiency of evidence
Whether conclusions follow from evidence, including negative or inconclusive results
human_review.decision: Reviewer records supported/refuted/inconclusive and rationale separately; automatic reward is not an overall success verdict.

limitations: No execution authentication or source-truth certification.
No automatic acceptance of the scientific conclusion.
legacy_policy: Files in tests/_support and tests/protected are inactive historical implementation/reference material, not imported or consulted by the open verifier.
